name: Syrup 2: Candy Alchemy RPG
source:
SYRUP 2: CANDY ALCHEMY RPG is a direct sequel to Syrup and the Ultimate Sweet. As the title implies, the series has evolved into a fully featured RPG! Synthesize candies, battle monsters, and complete quests while discovering more about the world beyond Atelier Sweets!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946750/Syrup_2_Candy_Alchemy_RPG/]Steam[/url], [url=https://nomnomnami.itch.io/syrup-2]itch.io[/url]]
